dimensions.assessment: Involves federal water and power administration officials, advisory work groups, and regional power contractors.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of the Interior... and the Secretary of Energy... in consultation with the Glen Canyon Dam Adaptive Management Work Group

dimensions.assessment: Requires the creation of an MOU and formal plan to analyze and address hydropower production costs, infrastructure obligations, and endangered species impacts.
dimensions.evidence: include the establishment of a plan to address the effects that the record of decision may have on Fund obligations

dimensions.assessment: Focuses on financial obligations and hydropower replacement costs affecting the Upper Colorado River Basin Fund, but does not appropriate new federal funds.
dimensions.evidence: address the impact that the record of decision has on hydropower production at Glen Canyon Dam, including costs to replace hydropower resources

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific interagency planning and consultation related to a single prior administrative record of decision.
dimensions.evidence: enter into a memorandum of understanding to explore and address the impact that the record of decision... has on the Upper Colorado River Basin Fund

dimensions.assessment: Requires an action as soon as practicable after enactment, resulting in a targeted planning document and MOU.
dimensions.evidence: As soon as practicable after the date of enactment of this Act... shall enter into a memorandum of understanding

missing_information: Dollar value of impacts on the Upper Colorado River Basin Fund
Timeline for completing the memorandum of understanding
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires federal agencies to enter into a memorandum of understanding and establish a plan addressing the impacts of a specific 2024 Glen Canyon Dam operational record of decision on the Upper Colorado River Basin Fund.
